description: dcom CI record (req-boot-bootstrap-ci-record, req-dcom-record) — the stack this plugin's own tests run in, and the one claim per-plugin CI is allowed to make: that dcom is correct against the dependencies it DECLARES and nothing else. The install set is dcom alone, because dcom declares no dependencies: core's `dimension` model is the only type it writes. The consumer (plugin-ci boot-and-test, or `spawn --dev-plugins dcom`) substitutes the checkout under test for the pinned self entry via tap.dev_workspace, so the CHECKOUT runs, not the pinned revision. Population seeds this plugin's own GRIFT, which is the whole of what it ships: seeding proves the dimension pack parses and imports against a real grid. DELIBERATELY EXCLUDED: every other plugin, all credentials, all required_secrets, and any population step that reaches the network — so a fork can run this lane and a nightly cannot flake on a third party (req-boot-bootstrap-ci-record-5). Reproduce CI exactly: spawn --from 'git+https://github.com/unified-systems-com/dcom-tap@dbe9b58bd4fbf8ee17ef4d6195d40bed1bdaa092#ci' --dev-plugins dcom

plugins.note: Self, pinned like any app-of-apps record — the CONSUMER (plugin-ci boot-and-test, or `spawn --dev-plugins dcom`) substitutes the checkout under test via tap.dev_workspace (req-boot-bootstrap-ci-record-4). Booting this record unflipped runs the pinned revision. Public repo, no credential (req-tap-plugin-arch-source-secret-5).

steps.note: Own GRIFT: seeding the dimension pack is the whole of what this plugin ships, and proves the bundle parses and imports against a real grid (req-dcom-record-1).
